xref.title: Death and Unanswered Questions
xref.body: Rockets Red Glare denied all accusations of murder, though he reportedly blabbed about what he did to friends and even tried to sell a snuff film of Nancy's murder. He died on May 28, 2001, from kidney failure, liver failure, cirrhosis, and Hepatitis C, exacerbated by morbid obesity, taking with him any potential answers regarding Nancy's death. "Rockets, Red Glare, died of kidney failure, liver failure, cirrhosis, and hepsi on May 28, 2001."
